playground_help: Requests are sent through this gateway with your dashboard key and show up in Audit Logs and Usage.
playground_model_search_placeholder: Search models or type a name…
playground_reorder_message: Drag to reorder (or use arrow keys)

playground_empty_response: The model returned no text. See the Response JSON for the full payload.
playground_json_empty_response: Send a request to see the response here.
playground_json_streaming: Streaming… the assembled response appears when the stream ends.
usage_label_help: One request can have multiple labels. Such a request counts once under each of its labels, so label rows can overlap and add up to more than the period totals.
usage_session_help: Sessions are ordered by latest activity. Request and token totals include local-cache hits; cost fields include provider spend only.
usage_prompt_cached_help: Provider prompt-cache reads included in the input tokens
usage_local_cached_help: Tokens served from GoModel's local response cache (excluded from the other columns)
usage_search_placeholder: Search by request ID, session, model, provider...
usage_search_label: Search by request ID, session, model, provider
usage_provider_cache_help: Share of input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache
usage_rewrite_estimate: Estimated at 4 net characters removed per token
usage_rewrite_tokens_removed: {count} estimated prompt token-transmissions removed across provider requests
usage_rewrite_summed: Savings are summed per provider request; resent conversation history is counted again
usage_rewrite_cache_excluded: Prompt-cache changes caused by rewriting are not included
usage_rewrite_comparison: {percent} than the same traffic without rewriting ({mode})
audit_retention_help: To change the retention period, set LOGGING_RETENTION_DAYS (environment variable) or logging.retention_days (config.yaml) and restart the gateway. The default is 30 days; 0 keeps audit logs forever.
audit_logging_disabled_before_config: Audit logging is off. Live entries are temporary and disappear after refresh. Set
audit_search_placeholder: Search by request ID, model, provider, path, user path, or error…
audit_search_label: Search by request ID, model, provider, path, user path, or error
audit_live_pause_date_range: Live paused — the selected date range does not include today. Set it to today to resume.
audit_live_pause_filters: Live paused while filters are active. Clear them to resume.
audit_live_pause_pagination: Live paused on later pages. Go to the first page to resume.
audit_thread_summary: Showing the latest {shown} of {total} requests in this session.
audit_view_session_usage: View total usage for this session
audit_rewrite_savings_help: Share of the request body removed by this rewrite

audit_request_body_too_large: Request body was too large to capture.
audit_response_body_too_large: Response body was too large to capture.
audit_rewritten_body_not_captured: Rewritten body not captured (body logging disabled or body too large).
audit_rewriter_unchanged_help: {rewriter} ran and forwarded the request unchanged
audit_audio_not_logged: Audio not logged. Set LOGGING_LOG_AUDIO_BODIES=true to capture playable audio.
interaction_following_latest_help: Following the latest interaction as new events arrive
interaction_viewing_history_help: Viewing a historical interaction; live updates are not followed
interaction_empty: No interaction data available for this entry.
interaction_cache_legend: Blue fill shows cached prompt share
interaction_truncated: Showing the newest part of this session and the selected log.
interaction_saved_unavailable: Message sent, but its saved interaction is not available yet.
interaction_request_step_help: Preview the selected request at any rewrite step. By default the final shape — what was sent to the provider — is shown.
interaction_prompt_cache_estimate: {percent}% of this visible prompt item is estimated provider-cached
overview_prompt_cache_rate_help: Share of input tokens served from the provider prompt cache over the selected period
overview_success_rate_help: Share of requests answered with a 2xx status
overview_provider_latency_help: Average duration of successful requests measured at the gateway for each provider. Local cache hits and failed requests are excluded; streamed responses count until the stream completes.
overview_provider_latency_average_help: Average duration of successful, uncached requests across all providers
overview_cache_share: Share of input tokens over the selected period
overview_no_usage: No usage in the selected period yet
overview_live_chart_label: Live token throughput, {window}. Input {input}, output {output}, prompt cached {prompt}, locally cached {local} tokens.
settings_timezone_help: Day-based analytics, charts, and date filters use your effective timezone. Usage and audit logs keep UTC in the hover title while rendering row timestamps in your effective timezone.
settings_budget_reset_all_help: Start new budget periods for every configured budget without changing the limits.
settings_budget_help: Budget reset anchors are stored in the database and evaluated in UTC. Hourly budgets reset at the top of each hour.
budgets_help: Budgets are evaluated from tracked usage cost records for each user path subtree. Enforcement runs only when Budget is enabled for the active workflow.
budgets_filter_placeholder: Filter by user path, label, or period...
budgets_filter_label: Filter budgets by user path, label, or period
budgets_edit_help: Editing a budget updates its limit only. Use Reset to start a new budget period.
budgets_user_path_segments: User path cannot contain "." or ".." segments.
budgets_period_positive: Period seconds must be greater than 0.
budgets_override_message: A budget for "{label}" already exists. Saving will override the current {current} limit with {next}.
budgets_delete_confirm: Delete budget "{label}"? This cannot be undone.
budgets_per_child_option_help: Each child below {subject} gets an independent budget. Deeper descendants share their direct child's budget.
budgets_per_child_title: An independent budget is created for each direct child path
budgets_per_child_before_subject: Usage is tracked independently for each direct child of
budgets_per_child_after_usage: as a child to inspect its budget.
models_filter_placeholder: Filter by provider, provider/model, alias, or owner...
models_filter_label: Filter models by provider, provider/model, alias, or owner
models_help: Add one target to make this a redirect/alias, or two or more to load balance across them. Leave Targets empty to create only an access policy for the Source selector.
models_managed_help: This virtual model is defined in configuration and is read-only here. Edit your configuration to change it.
models_session_keeping: Session keeping (route a detected client session to the target that served it)
models_user_paths_help: Use / to allow every user path. Use a team path to restrict to that subtree, or an unused path to make the selector unavailable.
models_slowdown_help: Adds a fraction of measured inference time: 0.5 adds 50%. Streaming chunks are buffered and released on the slowed timeline. Use 0 to override inherited slowdown, or leave empty to inherit it; active values are 0.1–10.
models_pricing_help: Currency is USD. Saved fields override model registry and config.yaml pricing for this selector; unset fields continue to inherit.
models_tiered_pricing_help: Tiered pricing exists for this override and will be preserved. Tier editing can be added without a database migration.
models_failover_managed: This failover mapping is defined in configuration and is read-only here.
models_drafts_no_match: No failover drafts match the filter.
api_keys_help: Managed API keys authenticate requests to the gateway. Deactivation is permanent — create a new key if access needs to be restored.
api_keys_filter_placeholder: Filter by name, description, user path, label, or token...
api_keys_filter_label: Filter API keys by name, description, user path, label, or token
api_keys_no_match: No API keys match the current filter.
api_keys_empty: No API keys yet. Issue a key to get started.
api_keys_store_warning: Store this key securely — it won’t be shown again.
api_keys_copy_failed: Unable to copy the key automatically. Copy it manually.
api_keys_expiry_help: optional, valid through the selected date
api_keys_user_path_help: When set, this key overrides the configured user path request header for audit logging and downstream request context.
api_keys_labels_help: Every request authenticated with this key gets these labels, in addition to any labels from tagging headers. Labels show up in usage analytics, the request log, and audit logs.
api_keys_dashboard_help: When off, this key is denied the dashboard and every /admin API endpoint. Model endpoints and GET /v1/usage stay available to the key. The master key always has dashboard access.
api_keys_dashboard_allow: Allow this key to use the dashboard and /admin API
api_keys_description_placeholder: What is this key used for?
api_keys_labels_edit_help: Applies to new requests made with this key. Leave empty to remove all labels.
mcp_help: Upstream Model Context Protocol servers whose tools, prompts, and resources the gateway exposes to clients. Dashboard-managed servers connect over HTTP or SSE; Config servers are read-only.
mcp_filter_placeholder: Filter by name, slug, URL, transport, or status...
mcp_filter_label: Filter MCP servers by name, slug, URL, transport, or status
mcp_empty: No MCP servers yet. Add one here, or declare servers in config.yaml under mcp.servers.
mcp_no_match: No MCP servers match your filter.
mcp_catalog_exposed: Exposed on the aggregated /mcp endpoint as {name}
mcp_catalog_empty: No tools listed — the server may still be connecting or degraded.
mcp_identity_help: The display name can change. The slug is the stable client-facing identity.
mcp_name_help: Human-readable and Unicode-friendly. You can change it later.
mcp_slug_create_help: Derived from the name. You may edit it before saving.
mcp_slug_edit_help: Immutable because it is used in URLs, scope headers, and aggregated tool names.
mcp_transport_help: Connect to a remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP or legacy SSE.
mcp_headers_help: Sent only to the configured server origin. Leave masked values unchanged to keep the stored value.
workflows_note: Active workflows are matched path-first: deepest user path wins first, then provider name and model specificity, then broader matches, then global.
workflows_filter_placeholder: Filter by scope, name, hash, or guardrail...
workflows_no_guardrails: No guardrails configured for this workflow.
providers_filter_placeholder: Filter by name, type, or base URL...
providers_filter_label: Filter providers by name, type, or base URL

providers_managed: Declared in configuration (config.yaml or env vars); read-only in the dashboard
rate_limits_filter_placeholder: Filter by subject, scope, or period...
rate_limits_filter_label: Filter rate limits by subject, scope, or period
rate_limits_no_match: No rate limits match your filter.
guardrails_disabled: GUARDRAILS_ENABLED is disabled. You can still manage Guardrails, but they will not run.
guardrails_filter_placeholder: Filter by name, type, user path, summary...
guardrails_help: Reusable policy objects stored in the database and kept hot in memory for Workflow execution.
guardrails_library_help: Store Guardrails in the database, keep them hot in memory, and attach them to Workflows by reference.
guardrails_instances_help: Each instance has a reusable name, a type, an optional user path for visibility scoping, and a JSON-backed config payload.
workflows_help: Create an immutable version. Submitting activates it for the selected scope.
workflows_scope_help: Leave provider name empty to target all providers and models. Select a provider without a model to target all its models.
workflows_path_help: Add a path to scope the Workflow to that subtree. Leading slashes are optional and normalized. The deepest user path matches first.
workflows_name_help: If the name is empty, the Workflow displays as its matched scope or All models.
workflows_description_placeholder: Optional operator note for why this version exists.
workflows_steps_help: Guardrails in the same numeric step run together. Later steps wait for earlier ones to finish.
workflows_no_registered_guardrails: No named Guardrails are currently registered. You can still draft a Workflow, but creation may be rejected.
rate_limits_editor_help: A user path rule limits the whole subtree; provider and model rules cap all traffic routed there. Leave a field empty to skip that limit. Token limits require usage tracking.
rate_limits_edit_help: Scope, subject, and period identify the rule. Changing any of them moves the rule and restarts its live counters.
guardrails_editor_help: Workflows reference these names directly, so renames are intentionally avoided after creation.
guardrails_description_placeholder: What this Guardrail is meant to do
guardrails_user_path_help: Only used for auxiliary rewrite Guardrails; ignored for other Guardrail types.
settings_budget_day_of_month_help: If the selected day does not exist in a month, the reset runs on the last day of that month.
settings_tagging_help: Each request is labelled from the listed headers; labels appear in usage tracking and audit logs. A header value can contain multiple labels separated by the delimiter (comma by default). The prefix is trimmed only from each label—the header itself is forwarded unchanged unless Do not pass is selected. Rows marked CONFIG come from config.yaml or TAGGING_HEADER_* environment variables and are read-only here.
settings_tagging_config_help: Declared in config.yaml or TAGGING_HEADER_* environment variables; read-only here.
settings_tagging_empty: No tagging headers configured. Requests are not labelled.
settings_runtime_refresh_help: Pull the latest model metadata, provider inventory, API keys, aliases, model access rules, Guardrails, and Workflows.
settings_pricing_help: Recalculate stored input, output, total, and Pro Saved costs from the current model pricing metadata. This overwrites matching historical cost fields. Filters apply to the selected date range, user path subtree, and provider/model selector or alias.
settings_pricing_confirmation_message: Stored usage cost fields matching the selected filters will be overwritten.

providers_session_sticky_hint: Keep each identified conversation on one API key to preserve provider prompt-cache affinity. Turn off to rotate keys round-robin on every request.
